name: Spring Into Work 2026

storyArc.angle: Introduce the spring capsule concept — 3 pieces that refresh her entire work wardrobe
storyArc.keyMessage: Spring doesn't have to mean a full closet overhaul. Three right pieces change everything.

storyArc.angle: Spotlight the blazer — the anchor piece of the capsule
storyArc.keyMessage: The blazer you'll reach for every Monday morning, in colors that actually work with what you own.

storyArc.angle: Show the full capsule styled three different ways — meeting, lunch, after-work
storyArc.keyMessage: One capsule. Three days. No outfit panic.

styleGuide.heroImageDirection: Woman in her 40s at a standing desk or conference room, blazer over blouse, natural light, confident but approachable expression

brief:
Spring Into Work 2026 targets the Polished Professional as she refreshes her work wardrobe for Q2. The campaign leans into the transition from heavier winter layers to lighter suiting and knit blouses — pieces that carry credibility without effort. The strategic angle is capsule thinking: 3 new pieces that work with everything she already owns.

Creative direction is clean and warm — navy and blush with bone white accents. No aspirational loft photography. Real offices, real women, real work days. Hero imagery should feel like a colleague she respects, not a magazine cover she can't relate to.

Across channels: email leads with a capsule framework (subject lines in the 'Formula' family), Instagram shows individual pieces in real work settings, and the site hero should carry a headline in the 'No-brainer workwear' register. CTA across all channels: Shop the Capsule.

styleGuide.heroImageDirection: Clean product flat-lay or model shot against white, jewelry or blazer as hero piece, minimal and editorial
